text.en: Explain how to set up Video Editing Studio in AGH. The owner installs and authorizes its separate runtime. Open Video Editor from the AGH sidebar to storyboard, edit and export local video.
text.zh-CN: 请说明如何在 AGH 中配置视频剪辑台。由所有者单独安装和授权运行组件。从 AGH 侧栏打开视频剪辑台，使用分镜、时间轴和字幕编辑并导出本地视频。
